title.narrative: Fiscal Consolidation Support Program
Programa de Apoyo a la Consolidacin Fiscal

description.narrative: El objetivo principal del programa es contribuir a la consolidacin fiscal deHonduras, por medio de medidas de poltica orientadas al fortalecimiento de la gestin macro fiscal, el aumento de la recaudacin de los ingresos fiscales, la mejora de la gestin del gasto pblico y la mejora de la gestin de los riesgos fiscales asociados a los pasivos contingentes. La presente operacin corresponde a la primera de dos operaciones bajo la modalidad de Prstamo Programtico deApoyo a Reformas de Poltica (PBP).

The main objective of the program is to support fiscal consolidation in Honduras through policy measures to strengthen macro-fiscal management, increase tax revenue collection, enhance public expenditure management, and improve the management of fiscal risks associated with contingent liabilities. This operation is the first of two in a programmatic series of policy-based loans
Commitment in 2015-11-25
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2015
